description: Add a product or service (by id) to your Marketplace cart with a quantity. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

quantity.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_market_add_item_to_cart
title: Market: add item to cart
